label: Sveriges politik
_comment_replaces: Replaces val2026. The election is decided, so the pulse, the pulse window, the cross-run pattern gates and the transition detector are gone rather than retuned - all four measured frequency across runs, and a sphere that runs once a night has no runs to count. What the sphere is FOR has changed with them: not what is happening in the campaign, but what the day's politics is actually about once the coverage has been read in full and something outside the coverage has been read alongside it.
_comment_feeds: Unchanged from val2026 on purpose. MEASURED over the election window (10 runs, 1145 items, docs/val-ledger.json): only 19 of these 28 URLs produced a single item. The nine silent ones are not deleted here, because the ledger records feed TITLES and not URLs, so which nine cannot be established from it - two of the titles seen ('Senast publicerat', 'Nyheter') are generic and could belong to several of these. Run one sweep with per-URL counts before cutting anything. What IS established: the analysis and opinion tier - Kvartal, Timbro, Arena Idé, Dagens Arena, Fokus - contributed 1 item in 24 hours between them, and Fokus's single item came under the title 'Fokus - Pliktleverans av elektroniskt material', which is almost certainly the wrong feed. Those outlets are now reached through researchDomains instead, which does not depend on their RSS working.
_comment_research: Where the tolkning tier comes from. One search query per cluster, formed from the lead headline; results whose host matches this list are kept as the analysis half, a couple of others as the open half. This is the list that decides what 'ett annat perspektiv' actually means, so it is deliberately spread across the spectrum rather than weighted to any part of it - a reading that only the think tanks on one side are offering is itself a finding, and invisible if only one side is listed. Adding domains here is cheap and costs no extra query.
_comment_selection: How the day's subjects are picked. Independent pickup replaces the old pattern gates: a story several unrelated desks decided to run is the honest daily equivalent of a pattern recurring across pulses, and it needs no time series. maxItemsPerSource is the one non-obvious lever - see the note in sphere-sverige.mjs. MEASURED: hd.se and sydsvenskan.se alone produced 352 of 1145 items in the election window, 31 percent, from two Skåne papers under one owner running largely shared copy. Uncapped, a national politics sphere clusters around the biggest regional desk.
_comment_provenance: Four tiers now. The first three are val2026's, unchanged and for the same reason. The fourth is new and is the only place this system says something its sources did not: verified = the text cites a primary document; reported = a named outlet asserts it under its own byline; circulating = an unconfirmed claim in circulation, described AS circulation and never carrying an entry alone; tolkning = read independently, from material nobody in the coverage cited. sphere-sverige.mjs drops any tolkning-tagged fact it cannot trace back to a host the researcher actually returned, so the label is arithmetic rather than the model's word for it.
_comment_script: Rendered by scriptSystemPrompt() under 'RULES SPECIFIC TO ...', after config.segmentStructure. Written to sit alongside ANNOUNCE / GROUND / SUBSTANCE rather than replace it.
scriptRules: Han har redan läst dagens bevakning. Referera den inte. Ämnet är vad fulltexten och den fristående researchen tillför utöver rubrikerna.
Säg vad bevakningen visade, och därefter separat vad researchen tillförde. Blanda aldrig de två i samma mening.
Ett faktum märkt tolkning kommer inte från bevakningen. Säg det rakt ut och namnge varifrån det kommer. Där det saknas ska ingenting sägas om saken.
Attribuera varje orsakssamband till den som hävdar det. Hävda aldrig ett samband i egen röst.
Ett påstående som bara cirkulerar namnges som obekräftat och beskrivs som cirkulation. Aldrig som faktum, aldrig som enda grund för ett stycke.
När underlaget är tunt, säg det i texten i stället för att skriva runt det. En ärlig mening om att detta vilar på två källor är värd mer än ett självsäkert stycke som döljer saken.
Opinionssiffror förekommer bara när ämnet är metod eller en uppmätt förändring över tid. Aldrig som ställning.
Skriv på svenska, för örat. Inga rubriker, inga punktlistor.
